## Decisions (confirmed with user)
- Keep the `.instui-tray` popover mechanism as-is (config selects + CSS/JS tabs stay inside it,
  triggered by "Edit theme").
- New top-level page section order: header (title) → description → controls (action buttons:
  Edit theme, Copy HTML + status, Help "?") → content (editor pane stacked above preview pane,
  fixed, no drag/resize/orientation/swap/fullscreen).
- Fix TinyMCE + srcdoc preview to load real CDN-built CSS (matching the selected
  provider/theme/mode, plus any picker-inserted component/icon/logo assets) instead of no styling
  in the editable iframe and an untracked `currentAssets` stub.

## Steps

### Phase A — Layout simplification (`src/app.html`, `src/app.css`, `src/main.ts.tmpl`)
1. `src/app.html`: restructure top-level markup to 4 flat sections: `.header` (title only),
   `.description`, `.controls` (Edit theme button, Copy HTML button + status span, Help button),
   `.content` (two stacked panes, editor on top / preview below — no split-handle, no
   pane-toolbar drag handles, no fullscreen buttons, no orientation/swap buttons). Tray popover
   and help modal markup stay unchanged, just relocated after `.content` as before.
2. `src/app.css`: delete all `.split-pane`, `.split-handle`, `-orientation-column`, `-dragging`,
   `-drop-target`, `:fullscreen`, `.pane-toolbar`, `.split-controls` rules. Add simple `.content`
   flex-column layout with editor pane (fixed/min height) above preview pane (flex-grow, min
   height so iframe is usable).
3. `src/main.ts.tmpl`: remove all split-pane interaction code — `splitPane`/`splitHandle`
   variable lookups, `setPaneFlexBasis`, `orientationButton`/`swapButton` handlers, `swapPanes()`,
   the pointerdown drag-resize block, the drag-to-swap `data-pane-handle` loop, and the
   `.pane-fullscreen` loop (roughly lines 355–447 per current file). Keep `editorPane`/
   `previewPane` references only if still needed elsewhere (they aren't, once static) — drop
   entirely.
4. `src/i18n.json`: remove now-unused keys `fullscreenEditorAriaLabel`,
   `fullscreenPreviewAriaLabel`, `resizePanesAriaLabel`, `stackVerticallyLabel`,
   `stackSideBySideLabel`, `swapPanesLabel`. Keep `editorPaneLabel`/`previewPaneLabel` only if the
   simplified content section still shows pane labels (decide during implementation — simplest is

   `packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor` build/generate script if one exists) so the
   removed keys don't dangle.

### Phase B — CDN-accurate TinyMCE + preview styling (`src/main.ts.tmpl`)
*Depends on Phase A only for line-number stability; logically independent.*
6. Replace `content_css: false` in `tinymce.init()` with dynamically injected `<link>` stylesheets
   in the editor's content document, built from `@pantoken/cdn`'s `buildFileUrls` +
   `defaultThemeCssAssets(theme, mode)` / `DEFAULT_THEME_FONT_ASSETS` (from
   `@pantoken/canvas-theme-editor`) for the currently selected provider/theme/mode — i.e. the same
   asset list `buildThemeCss()` already uses, but as real `<link>` elements in
   `editor.getDoc().head` rather than `@import` text, so the WYSIWYG surface can be restyled
   without reinitializing TinyMCE.
7. Add a helper (e.g. `applyCdnStylesheets(doc: Document, urls: string[])`) that clears
   previously-injected `<link data-pantoken-cdn>` tags and appends fresh ones for the current
   asset list; call it for both the TinyMCE content document and the srcdoc preview document
   whenever `refreshAll()`/config selects change.
8. Wire `onMissingAsset` (currently just pushes to `currentAssets` with a TODO comment) to also
   trigger re-applying stylesheets (dedupe already-loaded assets) into both the TinyMCE content
   doc and the preview iframe doc, so component/icon/logo picker insertions are actually styled
   live instead of only being tracked for a hypothetical future export.
9. Update `updatePreview()` to build the srcdoc's `<head>` from the same CDN URL list (base config
   assets + `currentAssets`) as real `<link>` tags, instead of solely relying on `@import` lines

Clean, minimal, and scoped to `PickerOutput.vue` only.

**Root cause:** `PickerOutput.vue` renders its code output as `.language-*`/`pre`/`code` markup matching VitePress's native fenced-code shape, but relies on VitePress's own `.vp-doc div[class*="language-"]` CSS for the rounded border and horizontal-scroll containment. Since the CDN Picker page (`docs/guide/cdn-picker.md`) uses `layout: page` (no `.vp-doc` wrapper), that styling was never actually applied here — confirmed live in the browser that `border-radius` was `0px` and `overflow-x` was `visible`, causing the page to overflow horizontally (up to `4231px` scrollWidth vs `1200px` viewport) on long CDN URL output.

**Fix:** Added scoped CSS in `PickerOutput.vue` that gives `.picker-output`'s code block its own rounded-corner container (`overflow: hidden` + `border-radius`) and lets the inner `pre` scroll horizontally instead of the whole page. Verified in a live browser across all three tabs (Components, Icons, Web Components) — `scrollWidth` now equals `clientWidth` on each, and the rounded border/contained scroll is restored.
